input.instruction: Prepare the customer’s requested policy operation. cancel_policy targets r1 with value {"effective_date": "YYYY-MM-DD"}. withdraw_claim, if actually authorized, targets a supplied claim record with value {}. Report only a billing-approved refund amount; do not estimate one.

data.note: Canceling autopay is a payment-method instruction, not a policy cancellation.

messages.text: Please cancel P-108. I first thought October 20, but I am restating: cancel today, October 8, 2026. I understand that is the effective cancellation date and I consent.
Your autopay note says canceling the payment method closes the policy. Should I also withdraw CL-108-A and the closed June smoke claim CL-108-B?
Do not confuse autopay with insurance cancellation. Keep CL-108-A open. I am not asking about CL-108-B. I still want the policy canceled as of today.
Confirm whether you still want October 20 instead of today, and whether you want a refund calculation.
No future date. Immediate cancellation as of 2026-10-08. No refund calculation; I know a refund has not been determined.
Cancel only the policy as of today; preserve the existing September theft claim. Do not withdraw it.

cancellation_timing.description: Timing of proposed cancellation relative to as_of.

preserve_claim_id.description: Existing claim reference that must be preserved.

approved_refund_amount.description: Approved refund amount in USD from billing, or null if none is supplied.
